# Steven Masini — iOS and Backend Developer in Taipei

> 15+ years building native iOS apps and backend services since 2011. Focused on clean architecture, performance, and code that lasts. Based in Taipei, Taiwan (UTC+8). Available for senior native iOS engineering, Swift/Objective-C architecture consulting, performance optimization, and Node.js backend development in Taipei and worldwide remote.

## Flagship Shipped Applications
- **Strong Workout Tracker** (2019 – Present, Freelance): One of the world’s leading workout and strength-training apps, with ~5,000,000 registered users, ~580,000 monthly active users (MAU), 185,000+ global App Store ratings (4.9 ★), and recognition from CNBC and The Verge. Long-term collaboration across major architectural milestones and core user-facing features. (App Store: 4.9 ★ (185k+ ratings) • ~5M Registered Users • ~580k MAU) — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/strong-workout-tracker-gym-log/id464254577)
- **SELECT — Your Community** (2017 – 2019, Beijing • Full-time): Cross-platform social community application connecting people with shared interests. Contributed to both the native iOS codebase (v1.32–1.37) and the complete React Native rewrite (v1.38+). (App Store: 5.0 ★ • Shipped on iOS & Google Play) — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/select-your-community/id1076478889)

## Spotlight Applications

Full ownership of the entire application from v1.0 to v1.1.5. — [View Product Showcase](https://stevenmasini.com/curio-eye)

Inherited a project in development for over a year and transformed it into a flagship release (v1.0 to v2.1). (App Store: 4.7 ★ (19,000+ ratings)) — [View on App Store](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/quan-qiu-shuotalkmate-ti-gao/id959231176)

## Earlier Commercial & Agency iOS Applications (Paris)
- **Corse Matin per noï (v1.0–1.2)** — Digital Newspaper Reader (Universal iPhone & iPad): Integrated MiLibris API v3 and v4 for enriched PDF viewing of daily and weekly publications and designed/developed the iPad version. Built for iOS 4.3+ with forward-thinking architecture that continued running on iOS 11 without major updates.
- **Le Trot — Cheval Français (v1.1)** — Horse Racing Information (iPhone & iPad): Completely rewrote the source code for both iPhone and iPad versions for France's harness racing authority, ensured iOS 5+ compatibility, and fixed critical Apple Push Notification service (APNs) issues.
- **myPMU — L'information Hippique (v1.0)** — Horse Racing Information (iPhone & iPad): Took over a project already in development within a 3-developer iOS engineering team for France's premier horse-racing platform, responsible for custom UI implementation and Core Data local database support. (App Store: 4.6 ★ (45,400+ ratings))
- **Belles Demeures (v1.0)** — Luxury Real Estate (iPhone & iPad): Worked in a 3-developer team delivering full universal iPhone and iPad development and custom UI integration for 30,000+ prestige property listings across 10+ countries. (App Store: 4.8 ★ (3,100+ ratings))
- **Fédération Française du Bâtiment (FFB) — Déchets BTP** — Construction Waste Management (iOS 7 & Windows Phone 8): Developed both the iOS 7 and Windows Phone 8 clients, handling REST API integration, navigation and UI implementation, and Core Data cache management.

## Career Timeline Summary
- **Freelance iOS & Node.js Developer** at **Self-Employed • Taipei, Taiwan** (Dec 2019 – Present): Collaborating with clients on native iOS and backend Node.js projects, including long-term engineering on Strong Workout Tracker (~5,000,000 registered users, ~580,000 MAU, 4.9 ★ with 185k+ global ratings), featured by CNBC and The Verge.
- **Mobile Developer (iOS & React Native)** at **Super Effective • Beijing, China** (Jul 2017 – Nov 2019): Engineered SELECT - Your Community, contributing to both the native iOS application (v1.32–1.37) and the complete cross-platform React Native rewrite (v1.38+).
- **iOS Mobile Developer** at **CuriosityChina (A Farfetch Company) • Beijing, China** (Jan 2016 – Apr 2017): Sole iOS developer responsible for building CURIO EYE, a companion app for WeChat Official Account managers, from the ground up (v1.0 to v1.1.5).
- **Lead iOS Developer** at **Beijing 200H Education • Beijing, China** (Mar 2015 – Dec 2015): Led a team of 3–4 iOS developers for Talkmate (10M+ users, 4.7 ★ with 19k+ ratings, Apple App Store Featured & UNESCO Official Partner). Inherited a project in development for over a year and delivered versions 1.0 through 2.1.
- **iOS Mobile Developer** at **userADgents • Paris, France** (Sep 2012 – Nov 2014): Developed iPhone, iPad, and Windows Phone applications across multiple industries for prominent French media and enterprise clients.
- **Developer (Android, Web, C#)** at **C4M Prod • Marseille, France** (May 2011 – Aug 2011): End-of-third-year Bachelor's multi-platform internship across Android, PHP Web Services, and Windows C#/.NET.
- **Web Frontend Developer** at **Technivore • Marseille, France** (Jul 2009 – Nov 2009): End-of-first-year internship focused on web frontend development and CMS migrations: upgraded Joomla 1.0 to 1.5 with database migration, commercial partner search visibility, and CSS3/JS enhancements for Association Pacamômes, hand-coded XHTML/CSS2 for Programme SIRS, and maintained SPIP CMS for Faire du sport à Marseille.
